parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional on action requests; honoured like the required key when present.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description:
The `ETag` the caller last saw. When it no longer matches the current
version the request is refused with 412 `version-mismatch`.

parameters.name: receiptId
parameters.description: The receipt id, `rcpt-` followed by a lowercase UUID.
